row.notes: Allocates a fresh 0x20 driver-record vector with the allocator at sys+0x10 and stores it at sys+0x260+slot*0x10 (allocator) / +0x268 (vector), freeing the old one; for slot 0 it walks gamedb table entrants.drivers and for every row with available!=0 reads first_name, last_name, full_name, last_name_standard, initials, is_name_reversed (XOR-decoded with k_Gdb_StringXorKey, localised through the language object at sys+0x228 index +0x160), nationality and audio_name (stat_id from entrants.nationality / entrants.audio_names), car_number, garage_slot_preference, f1_seasons_completed, head (entrants.animation.driver_heads), expression_label (entrants.expression_label), green/red/purple_rev_lights_configuration (sub-row rev_lights_configuration), chance_to_use_number_1, is_using_number_1_in_first_season, date_of_birth and ai_driver_config (Ai_Parse_DriverConfig), then calls Ent_EntrantsSystem_InsertDriverRecord with record id = stat_id<<16. Ends by posting a table-loaded message (vtable 0x14578f718, slot, vector) on g_Game_MessageBus; hook InsertDriverRecord or this loop to add or edit drivers at load.
